podcast.title: First Black Keys Label
podcast.body: This Los Angeles-based indie label was the only one to respond positively to The Black Keys' initial demo, leading to the release of their debut album, *The Big Come Up*. It marked the band's sole release with Alive Records. "Except one, a company that of Los Angeles called Alive."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Catching Up With The Black Keys

podcast.title: First Black Keys Signee
podcast.body: Alive, a Los Angeles-based company, was the only indie label to sign The Black Keys after they sent out their initial demo. It became the label for their debut album, *The Big Come Up*, and their only release with Alive. "Except one, a company that of Los Angeles called Alive."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
